title: Step 5 release coupling: switch vsdd-cli mdatron-core dep from local-path to published crate when v1.0 ships
description:
Goal: 

Acceptance criteria:
- 

When mdatron v1.0.0 publishes to crates.io, switch vsdd-cli's mdatron-core dep from local-path (current bootstrap-period state per SO-F3 build-in-mdatron-shape-from-day-one) to published-crate-dep. Trivial mechanical change in vsdd-cli/Cargo.toml: mdatron-core = { path = "../mdatron/mdatron-core" } becomes mdatron-core = "1.0". Flag this when mdatron v1.0 actually publishes. Closes the Phase 5 release-coupling step from the original 5-step bootstrap plan.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: CLOSED (superseded + discharged): the mdatron-core path dependency was eliminated by the #81 workspace collapse (vsdd consumes the mdatron BINARY), and the switch to the published crate landed at 0.5.0 (PR #21) — earlier than the v1.0 trigger this issue anticipated.
